#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int totalLines = 2;
    std::string inputs[2];
    for (int i = 0; i < totalLines; i++) {
        std::getline(std::cin, inputs[i]);
    }
    int n = std::stoi(inputs[0]);
    std::string text = inputs[1] + "_";

    bool inParentheses = false, inWord = false;
    int wordCount = 0, currentLength = 0, maxLength = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        char ch = text[i];
        if (inWord && (ch == '_' || ch == '(' || ch == ')')) {
            inWord = false;
            if (inParentheses) {
                wordCount++;
            } else if (currentLength > maxLength) {
                maxLength = currentLength;
            }
            if (ch == '(') {
                inParentheses = true;
            }
            if (ch == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
            }
            currentLength = 0;
        } else if (!inWord && !(ch == '_' || ch == '(' || ch == ')')) {
            inWord = true;
            currentLength++;
        } else if (inWord) {
            currentLength++;
        } else {
            if (ch == '(') {
                inParentheses = true;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxLength << " " << wordCount;
    return 0;
}
